review_response_tasks.stem: The witness gave an ____ account, admitting where her memory was uncertain instead of inventing details.
review_response_tasks.rationale: honest：承认不确定不编造=honest诚实；opaque不透/accidental偶然/edible可食不描述该诚实叙述。

review_response_tasks.stem: The apparent improvement was ____: it disappeared when the original conditions returned.
review_response_tasks.rationale: temporary：条件恢复就消失，temporary暂时；permanent永久反，inevitable不可避/identical相同不表持续短。

review_response_tasks.stem: The editor asked the writer to ____ between a personal opinion and a claim supported by records.
review_response_tasks.rationale: distinguish：distinguishbetween区分；consume消耗/appoint任命/borrow借不构成区分两类。

review_response_tasks.stem: He tried to ____ responsibility by blaming a colleague, although the records showed that he alone had caused the error.
review_response_tasks.rationale: evade：将自己的错误推给同事是evade responsibility逃避责任；calculate计算、transport运输、decorate装饰均不表达推责，且与抽象responsibility不构成此行为搭配。

review_response_tasks.stem: The new finding is consistent ____ the earlier observations.
Only after the final check yesterday ____ the technician release the equipment.
review_response_tasks.rationale: did：Onlyafter前置且yesterday明过去，did+release；does现在不合，has后应released，is不接release原形构成此倒装。

review_response_tasks.stem: Had we checked the address, we ____ sent the parcel to the wrong building.
review_response_tasks.rationale: would not have：Hadwechecked过去反事实，wouldnothavesent；will未来完成不合，arenot/do not不接sent此过去反事实。

review_response_tasks.stem: The report, ____ was published yesterday, includes all the revised figures.
review_response_tasks.rationale: which：非限制从句指report物作主语which；that不能此非限，what不能有先行词，who人。

review_response_tasks.stem: It is essential that every form ____ signed before submission.
review_response_tasks.rationale: be：that从句必须有谓语，此虚拟要求be signed；being/been非限定，tobe不能独立作that从句限定谓语。

review_response_tasks.stem: No sooner had the talk ended ____ questions began.
review_response_tasks.rationale: than：nosooner...than固定；when用于hardly/scarcely搭配，that/as不构成该关联。

review_response_tasks.stem: The two proposals differ not in cost ____ in the amount of time required.
review_response_tasks.rationale: but：notin...butin...并列纠正，but；so/because/unless不能连接两个in介词短语作该对照。

review_response_tasks.stem: The chair is believed ____ over a century ago.
review_response_tasks.rationale: to have been made：isbelievedto且过去已被制造tohavebeenmade；tomaking错，havemade缺to且主动，beingmake错。

review_response_tasks.stem: ____ all the evidence, the panel postponed its judgement rather than announcing a conclusion that afternoon.
review_response_tasks.rationale: Having considered：panel主动先考虑证据Havingconsidered；Considered被动与panel施受反，Toconsidering错，Considers限定不能作该状语。

review_response_tasks.stem: The aim is to make the process transparent, ____ to guarantee that everyone will agree with the result.
review_response_tasks.rationale: not：并列不定式对照notto guarantee；no/none/nothing不能直接否定此to不定式功能。

review_response_tasks.stem: I would rather you ____ the draft with me before sending it tomorrow.
review_response_tasks.rationale: discussed：wouldrathersb对未来愿望从句用过去式discussed；discuss非该时态形式，willdiscuss不合该虚拟愿望，discussing缺谓语。
